<!--- A feature is a shippable unit of the work that, when combined with other features, results in an epic being completed delivering customer value to support the business.
Add concise details to the sections below.   -->

## Overview
A clear and concise description of the feature.

## Value
Describe the value and impact the feature will have on `authnd` and/or GitHub.

## Proposal
A clear description of your proposal. Enter as much detail as the team needs to understand the scope, implement the spec, write tests, and ensure that the end product meets the acceptance criteria.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clear list of deliverables that ensures the completion of the feature.
<!---
* End to end testing has been completed
* Feature has been demoed to PM
...
-->

## References
A link to ADRs, conversations, or any other documentation that explains this feature or items that can be used as a reference.

## Subtasks
Tasks that are broken down into 1 to 2 days unit of work.
<!---
* [#xyz Example sub task](https://github.com/github/authnd/issues/xyz).
...
-->
